efn.warning.message.en: You have installed the EFN Mod, but the highly recommended companion mod AAA Particles is not currently installed.This mod significantly enhances the visual effects of EFN.
efn.warning.message.zh: 您已安装EFN模组，但未安装强烈推荐的联动模组AAA Particles。该模组能显著增强EFN的视觉效果
efn.warning.message.vi: Bạn đã cài đặt mod EFN nhưng chưa cài mod liên kết được khuyến nghị AAA Particles. Mod đó giúp nâng cao đáng kể hiệu ứng hình ảnh của EFN.

efn.warning.recommendation.details.en: For the best gameplay experience with EFN Mod, we strongly recommend installing AAA Particles. Without it, some visual effects may not display as intended or may be less impressive.
efn.warning.recommendation.details.zh: 为了获得最佳的EFN模组游戏体验，我们强烈推荐安装AAA Particles。如果不安装，部分视觉效果可能无法按预期显示或效果较差。
efn.warning.recommendation.details.vi: Để có trải nghiệm tốt nhất với mod EFN, chúng tôi khuyên bạn nên cài đặt AAA Particles.

efn.warning.bottom_hint.en: This message will only appear once. You can always download AAA Particles later if needed.
efn.warning.bottom_hint.zh: 选择任意选项后，下次启动将不再显示此提示。右上角×按钮仅关闭窗口。
efn.warning.bottom_hint.vi: Sau khi chọn, thông báo này sẽ không hiện lại trong lần khởi động kế tiếp.

skill.efn.efn_dodge.tooltip.zh: 朝你移动的方向翻滚。 闪避所有袭来的攻击。

skill.efn.efn_step.tooltip.zh: 朝你移动的方向快速移动一小段距离。闪避所有袭来的攻击。

skill.efn.efn_parry.tooltip.zh: 完美防御可以触发招架，并防止耐力消耗。可以防御远程攻击。

skill.efn.broadblade.tooltip4.en: Resolve: Damage increased to 1.5x when attack hits only one target
skill.efn.broadblade.tooltip4.zh: 决意：攻击只命中一个目标时，伤害提升至1.3倍

item.efn.ruinsgreatsword.description1.en: A massive sword excavated from beneath lava, surprisingly still functional after restoration
item.efn.ruinsgreatsword.description1.zh: 岩浆之下发掘的巨剑残骸，经过修复后竟然仍能使用

item.efn.meen_spear.description1.en: Forged entirely from Netherite, this exceptionally heavy lance defies conventional spear techniques.
item.efn.meen_spear.description1.zh: 通体由下界合金打造，异常沉重的大枪，寻常枪术难以在其上施展。

item.efn.nf_dual_sword.description1.en: A paired weapon discovered in an Ancient City, its crafting techniques lost to time
item.efn.nf_dual_sword.description1.zh: 于远古城市中发现的成对武器，制作工艺已无从考据

item.efn.sword_of_pioneer.description1.en: Commissioned by a king for his vanguard troops during their first Nether expedition, this exquisitely crafted saber remains as sharp as ever
item.efn.sword_of_pioneer.description1.zh: 曾有某位国王为了探索下界，为先头部队打造了做工精良的佩刀

item.efn.bloodlust.description1.en: A skeletal hand clutches the cursed blade shrouded in blood rust...
item.efn.bloodlust.description1.zh: §c§o骸骨紧握着被血锈覆盖的诅咒刀刃……

item.efn.kusabimaru.description1.en:
§lThe blade passed down by the Divine Heir of the Dragon's Heritage;
§i§lThe name 'Kusabimaru' carries a wish—even if a shinobi is fated to kill, they must never abandon the last shred of mercy in their heart...
item.efn.kusabimaru.description1.zh:
§f§i§l龙胤神子的相传之刃 
§7§l楔丸的名字里包含着心愿——'即使忍者注定是杀人的宿命,也不可舍弃仅有的一点慈悲之心'

item.efn.thornwheel.description1.en:
Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. 
As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss.
item.efn.thornwheel.description1.zh:
在轮子外围排满刀刃，用来撕裂皮肤的铁制大刺轮; 
旋转刺轮时，会带给敌人剧痛与出血。

item.efn.crescent_moon.description1.zh: §b§i§l这把武器能够炼化敌人的灵魂

item.efn.broadblade.description1.en: §lThe time has come to slay the enemy and serve the nation!

item.efn.exsiliumgladius.description1.en: §o§lA weapon from the Land of Exile. Wielding both blades unlocks its true form
item.efn.exsiliumgladius.description1.zh: §o§l来自放逐之地的武器，同时持有两把将解锁完全形态

item.efn.fire_exsiliumgladius.descriptio.en: §o§lA weapon from the Land of Exile. Wielding both blades unlocks its true form
item.efn.fire_exsiliumgladius.descriptio.zh: §o§l来自放逐之地的武器，同时持有两把将解锁完全形态

item.efn.duskfire_armor.description1.en: §c§l Heavy armor reforged from Netherite bathed in flames, its core pulses with residual embers
item.efn.duskfire_armor.description1.zh: §c§l 将下界合金沐火重铸的重甲,炉心迸发着余火

enchantment.efn.yamato_summoned_sword.de.zh: 允许阎魔刀召唤幻影剑

enchantment.efn.yamato_doppelganger.desc.en: Summon Doppelganger to assist in battle
enchantment.efn.yamato_doppelganger.desc.zh: 允许阎魔刀召唤同行者

enchantment.efn.yamato_heavy_rain.desc.zh: 允许阎魔刀使用五月雨[替换无门阵]

enchantment.efn.broad_blade_enhance.desc.zh: 解锁抗战大刀被动：革命

skill.efn.ruinsgreatsword.tooltip2.en: Channel all your strength into an upward swing. When clashing with enemy attacks, you'll negate their strike and follow up with a powerful combo
skill.efn.ruinsgreatsword.tooltip2.zh: 用尽全力向上挥击，成功与敌人攻击相撞时能抵消攻击并借势使出强力连击

skill.efn.ruinsgreatsword.tooltip3.en: Passive: Barbarian Arts - Hold both right-click and left-click simultaneously to charge
skill.efn.ruinsgreatsword.tooltip3.zh: 蛮勇——同时按住鼠标右键与左键进行蓄力

skill.efn.ruinsgreatsword.tooltip4.en: Charged attacks briefly negate incoming damage
skill.efn.ruinsgreatsword.tooltip4.zh: 蓄力攻击打出的一瞬间，能以蛮力抵消伤害

skill.efn.meenlance.tooltip1.en: Full energy——Hold both right-click and left-click simultaneously to charge
skill.efn.meenlance.tooltip1.zh: 满能量时——同时按住鼠标右键与左键进行蓄力

skill.efn.meenlance.tooltip2.en: Swing the spear to ignite residual flames, culminating in sweeping/thrusting attacks. At peak intensity, temporarily restores its former power
skill.efn.meenlance.tooltip2.zh: 用力挥动长枪，卷起狂风引燃残存的余火并顺势使出横扫或突刺，火焰燃至最盛时能够席卷全身，强化攻击力

skill.efn.meenlance.tooltip3.en: Passive: Flame Tempest - Use skill while "Embers" peak
skill.efn.meenlance.tooltip3.zh: 火焰风暴——“黄昏之火”效果期间，使用技能

skill.efn.meenlance.tooltip4.en: Release all stored flames and wind in a devastating whirlwind attack
skill.efn.meenlance.tooltip4.zh: 能进一步催发长枪的力量，伴随着挥舞，将枪中的火焰与风暴一口气全部释放

skill.efn.aetherialdusk.tooltip2.en: Quick tap launches enemies upward. Hold for a finishing strike
skill.efn.aetherialdusk.tooltip2.zh: 短按技能轻盈挑起敌人，长按技能则追加打出终结一击

skill.efn.aetherialdusk.tooltip4.en: Perfect dodges enable quick counters with attack buffs
skill.efn.aetherialdusk.tooltip4.zh: 在敌人命中前的瞬间闪避时，能够迅速跳开并趁机伤害敌人

skill.efn.pioneer.tooltip2.en: Initiate with rapid slashes, then break defenses with a hilt strike
skill.efn.pioneer.tooltip2.zh: 先以快速的斩击抢得先机，然后用剑柄打破对手的防御

skill.efn.bloodlust.tooltip2.en: Awaken the blade with bloodshed. Each slash carries sanguine power at the cost of continuous HP drain. Reactivate to end this state.
skill.efn.bloodlust.tooltip2.zh: 以鲜血唤醒刀刃，每次斩击都将附有血的力量，维持此状态时会持续流失生命，再次使用技能以结束状态

The mountains don't give back what they take...

 When holding 'HF-Murasama', hold [%s] to consume skill charge and enter 【Blade Mode】

 Duration: %.1f seconds × HF-Murasama's current weapon charge stacks
 Basic Operation: Move mouse left/right to switch slash direction
  · Click Left Button - Execute a single slash
  · Hold Left Button - Execute a reciprocating slash
 Advanced Operation: Hold [%s] to switch input mode
  In this mode, swipe mouse in 8 directions to directly execute slashes

◆ Finisher
 When slashes hit a certain number of times or target's health falls below a certain percentage
 Press RMB to execute 【Zandatsu】

※ This skill is exclusive to 'HF-Murasama', other weapons cannot use it

高山不会归还所得的一切...

  · 单点左键 - 释放一次斩击
  · 长按左键 - 释放来回斩击
- 进阶操作：按住[%s]切换输入模式

※ 此技能为'高频村雨'专用，其它武器无法使用
